lines.trans: With one hour and fifty-seven minutes until the scheduled Twelve Singers finale, I declare tonight's live broadcast will start on time.
Today's rainstorm is a disaster, and this is no moment for media professionals to run away.
Those stranded on the roads can no longer reach the studio on time, so we are abandoning the confines of the studio.
Performers and backstage colleagues of Twelve Singers, now is the moment to show what you stand for.
We have four celebrity guest acts, and Xingtian has dispatched camera crews to film their journey through the storm.
Order every outside broadcast van to power up, swing their cameras around, and report live from the gridlocked rainstorm.

words.gram: Meaning: report live on the scene.

examples.text: 演播室里的设备一人盯一台。
examples.trans: Assign one person to watch each piece of studio gear.

examples.text: 直播前技术组仔细测试了所有设备。
examples.trans: Before going live, tech staff tested all equipment.

meanings.note: verb for obligation when the moment arrives

examples.text: 该下锅时还是得下！
examples.trans: When it is time to jump into the pot, you still have to jump in!

examples.text: 该下锅时还是得下！
examples.trans: When it is time to jump into the pot, you still have to jump in!

meanings.note: Verb gǎn ('hurry; catch a plane or deadline').

examples.text: 董事长也连夜赶飞机回来了。
examples.trans: The chairwoman rushed onto a night flight back too.

examples.text: 我今晚得赶一篇稿子。
examples.trans: I have to rush an article tonight.

examples.text: 不改规则就跟对手的节目拉不开距离。
examples.trans: Without rule changes, we cannot open a lead over rivals.

examples.text: 保持适当镜头距离能让画面更自然。
examples.trans: Keeping proper camera distance makes shots look natural.

meanings.note: Production verb gēnpāi ('follow and film continuously').

examples.text: 从明天开始，摄像师就得二十四小时跟拍。
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow, camera operators shadow and film you nonstop.

examples.text: 跟拍导演需要敏锐捕捉嘉宾最自然的反应。
examples.trans: A follow-cam director captures guests' natural reactions.

examples.text: 在路上。
examples.trans: On the way.

examples.text: 路上小心。
examples.trans: Careful on the way.

examples.text: 他们俩吵架转移了红毯的注意力。
examples.trans: Their quarrel diverted attention away from the red carpet.

examples.text: 主持人巧妙地转移了尴尬的话题。
examples.trans: The host deftly steered away from the awkward topic.

examples.text: 这就是我在化妆间里的全部过程。
examples.trans: That is the entire course of events in the dressing room.

examples.text: 准备节目的过程非常辛苦。
examples.trans: The process of preparing a show is grueling.

examples.text: 这些资料，还有这四百个小时的录像资料。
examples.trans: These files, plus these four hundred hours of video recordings.

examples.text: 这是还有。
examples.trans: Translation.

examples.text: 这是谁的呀？
examples.trans: Whose is this?

examples.text: 这是谁的呀？
examples.trans: Whose is this?

examples.text: 危急关头绝不是媒体人该逃脱责任的时刻。
examples.trans: A crisis is never the moment for journalists to shirk duty.

examples.text: 任何弄虚作假的数据最终都无法逃脱观众的眼睛。
examples.trans: No faked numbers can ultimately escape the audience's eyes.

examples.text: 马上通知台里，红毯现场出了点问题。
examples.trans: Notify the network immediately about the red-carpet issue.

examples.text: 开会的时间已经通知大家了。
examples.trans: Everyone has been notified of the meeting time.

meanings.note: Film/TV noun jìngtóu ('camera lens or shot').

examples.text: 请各位歌手在镜头前做最真实的你们自己。
examples.trans: Singers, simply be your truest selves in front of the camera.

examples.text: 户外直播车迅速转移镜头，对准积水严重的路口。
examples.trans: The broadcast van swung its lenses toward the flooded intersection.

examples.text: 距离总决赛开播预定时间不到两个小时了。
examples.trans: Less than two hours remain until the scheduled finale airtime.

examples.text: 直播车按照预定路线准时抵达了中心广场。
examples.trans: The broadcast van reached central plaza on schedule along its route.
